notes: This file is a solver metadata map only; it does not modify mission databases.
Classes are conservative and derived from payload burden + inferred engineering fields.

derivation_rules_summary.adcs_class_required: Derived primarily from pointing_requirement_deg and deploy-mechanism likelihood; EXTREME if pointing<=0.05 deg or deploy mechanism likely; HIGH if pointing<=0.10 deg; MEDIUM if pointing<=0.20 deg; else LOW.
derivation_rules_summary.comms_class_required: Mapped from required_downlink_class: low->LOW, medium->MEDIUM, high->HIGH, very_high->EXTREME; communication payloads are floored at MEDIUM.
derivation_rules_summary.eps_class_required: Derived from avg/peak power and then bumped up if eclipse_operation_required and/or battery_discharge_sensitivity==high.
derivation_rules_summary.thermal_class_required: Derived from thermal_control_class (passive->LOW, passive_plus->MEDIUM, active->HIGH), bumped if temperature_stability_requirement==high; forced EXTREME for very high power payloads.
derivation_rules_summary.obc_class_required: Derived from compute_load_class, bumped for real_time latency and very high daily_data_generation_gb; certain comms/processing payload types are floored at MEDIUM.
derivation_rules_summary.structure_class_required: Derived from mass_kg, payload_envelope_u, deployment_clearance_needed, and recommended_bus_min_u (large/heavy/deploy-oriented payloads push to HIGH/EXTREME).
derivation_rules_summary.propulsion_need_class: Default LOW; raised for SAR/weather-radar (HIGH) and select defense geolocation/DF cases (MEDIUM), with a small bump for extremely tight pointing.
